one_liner: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and project tracking.

auth.notes: Also supports internal integration static tokens and user-created personal access tokens for single-workspace use; OAuth is the public-connection method for third parties.

access.evidence_quote: The Authorization URL field populates after a public connection is submitted for review.
access.notes: Free Notion account and developer portal access; public OAuth integrations that act on arbitrary workspaces go through a review/submission step.

api.notes: Notion has published an official remote MCP server; endpoint count not confirmed from this page, breadth estimated as narrow based on general knowledge of the REST API surface.

verdict.rationale: Free-tier OAuth2 API exists and is well documented, but production access to arbitrary workspaces requires submitting the public integration for review.
